The strongest evidence points to **emailservice degradation**: its memory rises from 43.9 MB to 130.4 MB and its open sockets from 3 to 10, while request rate stays low. At the same time, checkoutservice logs “no healthy upstream” when sending confirmations. The likely impact path is **emailservice → checkoutservice → frontend**. The Jaeger-exporter deadline warning may be related, but the telemetry does not establish it as the cause.
